## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/preflight_github.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/run_tests.py`
- [ ] New/changed physics behavior has a regression or benchmark where practical.

## Numerical impact

Describe any expected changes to fields, trajectories, spectra, polarization,
angular maps, or exported data.

## Scope

- [ ] No secrets or local credentials are included.
- [ ] No large generated result files are included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behavior changed.
